title: How Cedar Hollow got its afternoons back
prompt: Draft this into a two-page case study sheet for human services program leaders. The agency, people and figures are illustrative. End on a demo invite.

answers.audience: Human services program leaders (directors and supervisors)
answers.images: No images: use the brand library or the test image

try.proof: Change the headline to "How Cedar Hollow won back its afternoons", then answer one of the Check comments.
try.design: Drag the results chart above the caseworker quote, and retype the first stat's label.
try.revise: Say "the 41% should be 38%" and watch it change in every output.

more.prompt: Also make a PowerPoint deck from the same words, for a board meeting.
